items.title: Darnell Howard Interview, 1957-04-21
items.q: I know where Lombard is. Sure. You know, you knew you write music, you should have a ear. Yeah. Ta-da! Lombard up Telegraph Hill.

ctx.x: Did he have a good ear? Uh, yeah.
I know where Lombard is. Sure. You know, you knew you write music, you should have a ear. Yeah. Ta-da! Lombard up Telegraph Hill.
I want to say this, George Ween is a pest. I'm going to send him a bill for wasted tape.
